name: DELETE /api/voice-agent/trunks/:trunk_id - Remove a SIP trunk
description: Removes the LiveKit inbound/outbound trunks and dispatch rule (best effort) and marks the trunk deleted, freeing the slot for a new one; the Twilio trunk itself stays in the tenant's account. Idempotent. Audited as voice.trunk.deleted.v1 (506bbf30-2d83-440b-a853-1a8205f4b3cb#AC1). The API runner has no Twilio account or LiveKit SIP service, so its datasets lead with the deterministic refusals; the provisioning path is exercised against Twilio/LiveKit API stubs that check every request.

errorCases.when: no trunk with that id for the caller's tenant (includes another tenant's trunk)
